channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Adou Thiero | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Adou Thiero from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Austin Reaves on Matisse Thybulle, Ziaire Williams, Walker Kessler, Adou Thiero
item.description:
Lakers guard Austin Reaves on Wednesday:

“Trying to score on Matisse (Thybulle) and Ziaire (Williams), especially with Adou (Thiero) out there too, and then Walker (Kessler) on the back line is not easy.“I had to deal with that all day yesterday and today, and it's not fun.”

Austin Reaves on Matisse Thybulle, Ziaire Williams, Walker Kessler, Adou Thiero, Sep 30, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: JJ Redick on Adou Thiero
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:JJ Redick on what he’s seen out of Lakers rookie Adou Thiero’s athleticism thus far in training camp:

“He’s … it’s insane. I mean, head at the rim. It’s insane. It’s insane.”

JJ Redick on Adou Thiero, Oct 11, 2025. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Austin Reaves on Adou Thiero
item.description:
Austin Reaves on Adou Thiero:

“I told him before, I was like I want you to make the game as nasty as possible, like run somebody over, go get offensive rebounds……He’s so athletic, like he’s almost like — If there’s a thing of too athletic he’s almost that”

Austin Reaves on Adou Thiero, Oct 4, 2025. Source: Twitter.
